name: vibe-coding-toolkit
description: A curated marketplace of Claude Code agents, skills, commands, hooks, rules, MCP configs, and workflow bundles.

plugins.name: review-suite
plugins.description: Automated code review: a code-reviewer and security-auditor subagent, a quality-review skill, and a post-edit lint/format hook.

plugins.name: growth-ops
plugins.description: Domain-expert bundle for marketers: a growth-analyst subagent plus skills for campaign briefs and ad-copy compliance review.

plugins.name: safe-ops
plugins.description: Safety rails: hooks that block edits to protected branches and files, plus an auditable rules set for sensitive paths.

plugins.name: mcp-connectors
plugins.description: A starter bundle of commonly used MCP server configs (GitHub, Postgres, filesystem, Slack) you can enable individually.
